purpose: Declarative staging-merge interpretation for step 09; this file deploys no controller and grants no merge.

thresholds.use: Playground/shadow examples only. Production requires approved completion calibration for the pinned model and question version. Missing, nonnumeric, nonfinite or out-of-range scores are invalid; missing/invalid answers block interpretation. Middle-band values are uncertain, not passes.

preparation: WFRelease 08 refreshes the evidence on the reviewed head in any readable format: original AC, per-AC acceptance evidence with its source and head association, independent review results and open threads, CI results, QA Develop record with the Ready for Staging status change, stage requirements, rollout notes, release notes and approvals.
Label implementer claims separately from observed facts. Record unretrieved items as gaps; never fill them with defaults or older results.
Do not add a merge recommendation, a computed gate result or an expected answer to the state.
factual_gates: The Ready for Staging status change was made by an authorized QA identity and the stand comment matches the reviewed head.
The PR head is unchanged since review and QA; a new head returns to 05 for review, it is not a wait.
Required CI passed on the reviewed head.
No unresolved review thread and no changes-requested review from Codex, the verification session or a human.
The PR is mergeable under branch protection: approvals present, no conflicts.
No release freeze and the staging window is open.
The `merge` grant is held; when CI deploys on merge, the merge is the staging deployment.

outcomes.when: Any factual gate fails or its evidence is missing
outcomes.action: Stay in Ready for Staging under WFRelease 08; record the exact blocker, owner and wake-up event. Do not call Jev to compensate for a factual gap.

outcomes.when: Any required answer is missing or invalid
outcomes.action: Retain the ticket; do not substitute an expected answer.
Ask the named release owner for the exact decision; the answer returns through WFRelease 08 and 09 re-runs.

outcomes.when: Any required predicate fails or is uncertain
outcomes.action: Record the failing predicates as blockers with the missing evidence as wake-up; uncertainty is investigated, never treated as a pass.

outcomes.when: All factual gates pass, every required predicate passes and the `merge` grant is held
outcomes.action: Run step 10. This is eligibility, not an executed merge.

combination: Apply factual gates before reading answers. Each required predicate is judged on its own; no weighted average or product across answers. Retain every blocker and human item even when one sets the outcome. A recommendation never proves correctness or authorizes execution; the example policy is shadow with `merge` disabled, so every outcome is recorded as a recommendation.
